description: Syllables written without a tone mark that the VieNeu road cannot say as written: rimes of romanized names (Korean RR, romaji) the voice does not know, syllables sea-g2p gives a tone, Vietnamese words sea-g2p has no Vietnamese sound for, and the onset letters of a foreign roster name spelled like a Vietnamese syllable that are read as another Vietnamese letter (Dan: đan). Measured 2026-11-10/11 on VieNeu v3 Nano and heard by the owner 2026-11-11; method and numbers in docs/NAME_SOUNDS.md. Read by phoneme_policy.py and PhonemePolicy.kt.
